selection_rule: Momentum Score only; market cap never reorders the ranking
classification: research comparison; the production default stays Beta 0.5 and is not chosen by maximising historical CAGR

beta_0.5.formula: score x (float cap / median float cap) ^ 0.5

beta_1.formula: score x (float cap / median float cap) ^ 1

point_in_time_coverage.cached_bar_fields: date, open, high, low, close, adjusted close, volume, dividends, splits
missing_fields: sector classification as known on each rebalance date

point_in_time_coverage.conclusion: No point-in-time float-adjusted market cap exists in the project's data layer. A historical test of the Beta 0.5 sizing rule is therefore not available, and current float caps are never substituted for past values.

historical_comparison.reason: point-in-time float-adjusted market capitalisation coverage is 0%, so CAGR, Sharpe, drawdown, turnover and sector concentration cannot be compared across betas without look-ahead bias

proxy.interpretation: All three exponents produce the same book because the historical proxy has no size input. These numbers describe the equal-weight momentum proxy, not the Beta 0.5 production rule.

limitations: The current cross-section uses today's float caps on today's signal date; that is not a backtest.
No historical float, shares-outstanding or point-in-time sector history is available.
The equal-weight proxy is published separately and never labelled as validating Beta 0.5.
Survivorship: the universe is today's list, not a point-in-time membership record.
